review_role: Independent model cross-check by chapter9–40 author; not specialist review
methods: Read authored stems, options, rationales, direct-card wording and staged case information
Compared cited evidence paragraphs and raw page-marked text
Recalculated simple percentages and checked threshold direction
Rendered and visually inspected PDF40 Table2.4 for live-birth definition
Checked cognitive demand against depth labels and staging for future-information leakage
Isolated import assertions checked counts, unique options, answer-note alignment and chapter page bounds

items: MCQ1 option notes Virginia Apgar/William Silverman
substantive_findings.issue: Distractor explanatory facts were correct but their original PDF21 citation did not contain each historical biography.
substantive_findings.action: Added exact note-page overrides25,27,32 in batch_001_004.py, preserving deterministic option alignment.

substantive_findings.issue: A basic applied consistency-of-measure question was labeled Deep Dive.
A straightforward comparability decision was labeled Deep Dive.

chapter_observations.1: Historical attribution,1960 quote in raw PDF21, ACTH placebo comparison and oxygen-retinopathy lesson supported. Historical distractor biographies needed separate page citations.
chapter_observations.2: Risk differences recalculated:0.1 and10 percentage points; RR2 for both. Live-birth wording checked in rendered PDF40 Table2.4, including heartbeat without breathing and no cord-cutting prerequisite.
chapter_observations.3: Structured/unstructured examples, data validation, ascertainment-bias example, rare-outcome research and network measures supported. Measure-consistency task is application rather than Deep Dive.
chapter_observations.4: Trust, benefits/burdens, shared and personalized decisions, emotional deliberation and physiologic-versus-value definitions of viability supported.
chapter_observations.5: Donabedian, Model for Improvement, balancing growth measure, shared baselines and stable definitions supported. Comparing differing case definitions is application rather than Deep Dive.
chapter_observations.6: Simulation practice, competence versus time, debriefing versus briefing/feedback, in-situ threats and low-fidelity HBB supported.
chapter_observations.7: Packages of care, hypothermia below36.5C, heat-loss practices, clinical-sign sepsis assessment and complementary prematurity care supported. Scalability/coverage consolidation supported.
chapter_observations.8: Mortality windows, social determinants, social framing of race, preconception care and practical urban/rural access barriers supported.
